targetTexts.1: These are the proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel,
targetTexts.2: for gaining wisdom and discipline, for comprehending words of insight,
targetTexts.3: and for receiving instruction in wise living and in righteousness, justice, and equity.
targetTexts.4: To impart prudence to the simple and knowledge and discretion to the young,
targetTexts.5: let the wise listen and gain instruction, and the discerning acquire wise counsel
targetTexts.6: by understanding the proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.
targetTexts.7: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
targetTexts.8: Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction, and do not forsake the teaching of your mother.
targetTexts.9: For they are a garland of grace on your head and a pendant around your neck.
targetTexts.10: My son, if sinners entice you, do not yield to them.
targetTexts.11: If they say, “Come along, let us lie in wait for blood, let us ambush the innocent without cause,
targetTexts.12: let us swallow them alive like Sheol, and whole like those descending into the Pit.
targetTexts.13: We will find all manner of precious goods; we will fill our houses with plunder.
targetTexts.14: Throw in your lot with us; let us all share one purse”—
targetTexts.15: my son, do not walk the road with them or set foot upon their path.
targetTexts.16: For their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed blood.
targetTexts.17: How futile it is to spread the net where any bird can see it!
targetTexts.18: But they lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush their own lives.
targetTexts.19: Such is the fate of all who are greedy, whose unjust gain takes the lives of its possessors.
targetTexts.20: Wisdom calls out in the street, she lifts her voice in the square;
targetTexts.21: in the main concourse she cries aloud, at the city gates she makes her speech:
targetTexts.22: “How long, O simple ones, will you love your simple ways? How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?
targetTexts.23: If you had repented at my rebuke, then surely I would have poured out my spirit on you; I would have made my words known to you.
targetTexts.24: Because you refused my call, and no one took my outstretched hand,
targetTexts.25: because you neglected all my counsel, and wanted none of my correction,
targetTexts.26: in turn I will mock your calamity; I will sneer when terror strikes you,
targetTexts.27: when your dread comes like a storm, and your destruction like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish overwhelm you.
targetTexts.28: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will earnestly seek me, but will not find me.
targetTexts.29: For they hated knowledge and chose not to fear the LORD.
targetTexts.30: They accepted none of my counsel; they despised all my reproof.
targetTexts.31: So they will eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
targetTexts.32: For the waywardness of the simple will slay them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them.
targetTexts.33: But whoever listens to me will dwell in safety, secure from the fear of evil.”
